subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Should Feishu conversation binding use explicit peer syntax, channel-specific Feishu ID inference, or another compatibility plan for the existing `--bind <channel>:<account>` CLI contract?
rationale: The bug is real, but the PR changes a documented CLI grammar that writes persisted route bindings and multiple open candidates make different compatibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer syntax
options.body: Keep `feishu:<account>` as an account bind and add a documented peer form such as `feishu:group:<id>` or another explicit conversation syntax.

options.title: Adopt Feishu ID inference with safeguards
options.body: Map known Feishu conversation-id prefixes into peers while preserving unrecognized account names as account bindings and documenting the heuristic.

options.title: Pause this branch and choose another candidate
options.body: Use one of the sibling candidate PRs if maintainers prefer its compatibility shape and proof path after conflicts are resolved.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer syntax
recommendation.body: Keep `feishu:<account>` as an account bind and add a documented peer form such as `feishu:group:<id>` or another explicit conversation syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the original account-scoped bind CLI surface that the product-direction choice would change.
